transcript.answer:
ADR-002 (accepted 2026-09-25) settled this in response to PR #261 review comment 4098626654, where a reviewer proposed dropping the card and letting the model phrase the answer. It rejected that proposal, so the card stays and the assistant's own prose stays suppressed. Three reasons:
1. KPIs. The card-rate KPI (SC-006, ≥90% by 2026-Q4) counts cards, so a prose answer has no denominator. The thumbs-up KPI (SC-007, ≥80%) also depends on the card, because ratings attach to card turns and a prose answer produces no rating.
2. Compliance and trust. The EU AI Act data-flow record and the docs/danish-review.md rows promise that the customer reads delivery status verbatim from the TMS. A paraphrased or invented delivery time or ETA is the one hallucination the pilot can't afford.
3. Spec. FR-043 of support-agent-tms-tools is amended to permit a deterministic-render tool. The not-found card is deterministic for the same reason: the model can't invent a shipment it didn't fetch.
The reviewer's concern was that a rigid card reduces the model's flexibility. The ADR judged that cost acceptable.
